assumptions.reporting: Both providers report promptly after the season; "not enough data" is a report too, so a dispute opens at once. Only a silent provider would make settlement wait for the 14-day report deadline (not modelled).
assumptions.resolution: No unanimous dispute resolution; apply the signed fallback as soon as eligible. Transactions still need an operator.
assumptions.timing: Modelled whole days after season end, not measured delivery time. Excludes data publication lag and transaction latency.
assumptions.evaluation: Retrospective comparison on pinned final data, not an independent holdout or a reconstruction of what was available at the time.

scope: Post-review exploratory design comparison. No new method selection, independent holdout, observed payment times, household losses or real aid outcomes.
